steps.text: Hey ❤️ I'm downstairs, and your dessert survived the bus
What about you?
Less impressive condition, but still edible
AVAILABLE 😭
I'm opening the door before you make it worse
Please do

Around six, you open the door. {{name:lena}} sets the pastry bag down and wraps both arms around you before you've finished saying hello. She kisses your cheek and stays against you for another moment, then steps inside.

20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.

The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.

20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.

Her phone goes back into her bag. When you pull the blanket over her feet, she turns toward you instead of the screen. "What?" you ask. "Nothing. Come here." She rests her head against you and holds your hand under the blanket. It takes a nudge from you before she notices the film has already started.

80 MINUTES LATER — You spend the film close together, occasionally arguing about whether the lead actor is meant to be funny. When the credits roll, she stays for another few minutes before getting her things. At the door, she gives you a longer hug, promises to text when she is home, and heads for the bus.
20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
I'm home ❤️ Thank you for tonight
Did you get back okay?
Yeah, got a seat and almost fell asleep before my stop 😭
You left your hair tie on the sofa
Keep it, I'll need an excuse to steal that cushion again
You don't need an excuse
I know ❤️
You went quiet a couple of times tonight
Sorry, I had a lot on my mind
Did I do something?
No, you didn't do anything wrong, your perfect
I was really happy to be there with you
I was happy you came
Me too, I'd missed being next to you instead of watching from my end of a screen
Much easier for you to steal the blanket
That too 😌
And I liked your film, even if I still don't think that man was meant to be funny
You laughed more than I did
Mostly at you laughing at him
I'll take it
The dinner was really good too ❤️
Even without all my chicken on your plate?
Don't start, I took one piece 😭
Get some sleep, you looked ready to fall asleep on me
I nearly did. It was nice not having to go anywhere for a while
We'll do it again
I'd like that
Good night handsome, love you ❤️
Love you too, sleep well
